caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded jug with a narrow neck and a handle attached from the neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The jug is rendered in shades of light beige and gray, with blue highlights accentuating the rim and handle. On the body of the jug, there are two birds illustrated with simple outlines and blue wash, one on the left standing on a branch and the other on the right perching on a small round object or ball. The rightmost bird and the handle feature more prominent blue coloring. Details such as leaves or branches are drawn beneath the left bird. The drawing also includes an inset in the upper left corner showing a close-up of the jug's mouth and handle, emphasizing the blue glaze and form of the handle. The entire composition is set within a lightly outlined rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "Yolande Delasser," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
